Package dev.px.core.event

Annotation Interface Subscribe

@Documented @Retention(RUNTIME) @Target(METHOD) public @interface Subscribe
Marks a method as an event handler.

The method must take exactly one parameter, and that parameter's type is the event it receives — there is no type token to keep in sync. Handlers may have any visibility and any name. 


 @Subscribe(priority = Priority.HIGH, stage = Stage.PRE)
 private void onMotion(PlayerMotionEvent event) {
     event.setYaw(rotation.getYaw());
 }

      Default:

      Stage stage

    • receiveCancelled

      boolean receiveCancelled
      Whether to still run once another handler has cancelled the event.
      Default:

    • ignoreListening

      boolean ignoreListening
      Whether to run even while the owning Listenable reports that it is not listening — for a Module, that means while it is disabled.

      Use it for handlers that must observe the game regardless of toggle state, such as a keybind watcher or a statistic counter.

      Default:
      false
